title: Tray chip arming (chip → type_idx → Cmd_Place_Router) has zero automated coverage
detail: Acceptance #1/#2 (three router chips; placing each tier works) depend on this app path, but every automated test bypasses it: core tests call topology_apply_edit directly and harness `place` directives log commands without the tray. Guards call wrong-tier chips a real defect.
recommended_fix: Lift the chip-index→type_idx mapping into a pure proc with a unit test (chip 3/4/5 → basic/mid/high, catalog order), or add a harness scenario driving placement through the tray arming path.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: separation boundary/floor, 8/16 port ceilings, data-driven balance parsing with 7 negative rows, replay E10 — all unit-pinned plus router_ceiling/router_tiers T1+T2 goldens. P1 ≥90%. Overall ≥80%. One P2 gap (tray arming) does not breach thresholds.
recommended_fix: None required for the gate; closing the tray-arming gap (app-layer pure-proc unit test or harness tray scenario) would make coverage airtight.
